arc.heading: Architecture (ARC)
arc.version_note: Current public chapter; no edition inferred from download-navigation labels.

ARC 109.name: Introduction to Architecture
ARC 109.description: Introduces architectural design through drawing, models, spatial analysis and lectures in history and theory.

review.rationale: Practical design and historical interpretation both explicitly guide the course.

ARC 110.name: Visual Studies
ARC 110.description: Develops architectural drawing, digital representation and fabrication skills through a portfolio.

review.rationale: Architectural visualization is the domain; digital tools do not alone establish programming foundations.

ARC 121.name: Architecture and Culture
ARC 121.description: Examines architecture through aesthetic theory, language, form, context and case studies.

review.rationale: The source explicitly treats architecture as an intellectual and aesthetic discipline.

ARC 122.name: Architecture and Behavior
ARC 122.description: Relates human behavior, cultural diversity, equity and psychology to building design.

review.rationale: Social interpretation and applied design are both explicit.

ARC 141.name: On-Site Survey of European Architecture and Urbanism
ARC 141.description: Surveys European buildings and cities on site through their historical development.

review.rationale: Historical architectural study establishes human context.

ARC 223.name: Architecture and the Environment
ARC 223.description: Studies building responses to climate, energy, ecosystems and environmental conditions.

review.rationale: Environmental building design is the substantive domain.

ARC 230.name: Building Technology I: Materials and Methods
ARC 230.description: Studies building materials, construction processes, structural enclosures and basic codes.

review.rationale: Practical construction knowledge is central, not computer-system infrastructure.

ARC 231.name: Building Technology II: The Elements of Structure
ARC 231.description: Analyzes building structural elements through statics, loads, materials and equilibrium.

review.rationale: Engineering analysis of physical buildings is the described application domain.

ARC 267.name: History of Architecture I: Ancient, Medieval and Renaissance
ARC 267.description: Studies architecture and urban design from early societies through the Renaissance.

review.rationale: Historical built environments and regional traditions define the subject.

ARC 268.name: History of Architecture II: Baroque through Contemporary
ARC 268.description: Studies architecture and urban design from the seventeenth century to the present.

review.rationale: Historical architectural and cultural development establish the subject.

ARC 292.name: Introduction to Architecture Design I
ARC 292.description: Introduces nonmajors to architectural practice, visual awareness and design procedures.

review.rationale: The central content is professional design practice.

ARC 293.name: Introduction to Architecture Design II
ARC 293.description: Extends nonmajors' architectural design through engineering, building technology, sites and climate.

review.rationale: Applied building design and its engineering relationships organize the course.

ARC 294.name: Introduction to the Development of Architecture
ARC 294.description: Introduces nonmajors to design processes and architecture's cultural, social, economic and technological influences.

review.rationale: Design methods and contextual historical interpretation are both explicit.

ARC 323.name: On Site Study of Selected Architecture and Urbanism
ARC 323.description: Studies selected buildings and urban precedents on site with attention to periods and architects.

review.rationale: The course examines historical architectural examples.

ARC 371.name: Ancient Architecture
ARC 371.description: Traces ancient architecture and settlement across Europe, the Middle East and the Mediterranean.

review.rationale: Historical human environments define the course.

ARC 373.name: Early Christian, Byzantine, and Medieval Architecture
ARC 373.description: Studies Christian, Byzantine and medieval architecture and settlements across several regions.

review.rationale: The substantive content is architectural history.

ARC 382.name: Architecture and Culture in Italy
ARC 382.description: Develops historical and cultural context for the Rome program through architecture, arts and politics.

review.rationale: Cultural interpretation prepares students for a separate program; it is not an AI-degree obligation.

ARC 475.name: Colonial Architecture
ARC 475.description: Studies colonial buildings and settlements across the Americas, Caribbean, India and Africa.

review.rationale: Historical architecture and settlement establish human context.

ARC 476.name: 19th and 20th Century Architecture
ARC 476.description: Studies American and European architecture in relation to cultural, technological and theoretical change.

review.rationale: The course concerns historical development rather than technical computing methods.

ARC 511.name: Visual Representation I
ARC 511.description: Develops architectural drawings and models as tools for analysis and communicating design ideas.

review.rationale: Applied architectural representation is central.

ARC 512.name: Advanced Visual Analysis
ARC 512.description: Uses drawing to analyze composition, light, color and visual experience.

review.rationale: The described skill is visual analysis for design practice.

ARC 513.name: Advanced Visual Representation
ARC 513.description: Develops architectural modeling, parametric geometry and presentation using digital and graphic techniques.

review.rationale: Applied architectural representation remains the subject; named software does not prove programming instruction.

ARC 514.name: Michelangelo
ARC 514.description: Uses drawing across media to investigate and interpret Michelangelo's work.

review.rationale: Practical visual research and historical interpretation both organize the course.

ARC 516.name: Architectural Watercolor Renderings
ARC 516.description: Uses sketches and watercolor to study buildings and urban settings in South Florida.

review.rationale: Applied visual recording and architectural analysis are central.

ARC 517.name: Construction Documents
ARC 517.description: Studies construction drawings and specifications through case examples.

review.rationale: Professional construction documentation is the stated activity.

ARC 519.name: Architecture and Color
ARC 519.description: Studies color's history and theory alongside its use in architectural design.

review.rationale: Historical aesthetic interpretation and practical design receive explicit attention.

ARC 527.name: Architecture Photography
ARC 527.description: Develops photographic principles and techniques for architectural subjects.

review.rationale: Practical photography is the domain, without an asserted AI or image-processing method.

ARC 528.name: Historic Preservation
ARC 528.description: Develops rehabilitation principles for historic buildings and districts using significance analysis and preservation standards.

review.rationale: Applied preservation design is central.

ARC 539.name: Adaptation to Climate Change
ARC 539.description: Examines climate evidence and mitigation while developing proposals for adapting to changed conditions.

review.rationale: Environmental adaptation planning is the substantive application domain.

ARC 540.name: Tropical Architecture
ARC 540.description: Analyzes and documents tropical architecture through selected case studies and drawings.

review.rationale: Architectural analysis and representation establish the domain focus.

ARC 541.name: Seminar on Town Design
ARC 541.description: Analyzes urban-design concepts and critiques current town and city projects.

review.rationale: Applied urban design is the explicit subject.

ARC 544.name: Architecture of Palladio
ARC 544.description: Studies Palladio's buildings and urbanism on site through artistic precedents in the Veneto.

review.rationale: Historical architectural interpretation is central.

ARC 545.name: Urban Composition
ARC 545.description: Examines urban spaces through composition and their economic, social and cultural conditions.

review.rationale: Design analysis and human context are explicitly combined.

ARC 546.name: Studies of Havana
ARC 546.description: Analyzes Havana's buildings and urban structure through mapping, history and imagery.

review.rationale: Spatial design analysis and historical interpretation both contribute.

ARC 547.name: Architecture and Urban Identity
ARC 547.description: Studies how architecture and urban form produce identities and images of place.

review.rationale: Cultural meaning in built environments is the organizing concern.

ARC 551.name: Contemporary Theories of Architecture
ARC 551.description: Examines theoretical currents and movements shaping modern architecture.

review.rationale: Architectural intellectual history and interpretation establish human context.

ARC 554.name: Architecture of South Florida
ARC 554.description: Traces South Florida architecture, settlements and urban development through significant places.

review.rationale: Regional architectural history is the subject.

ARC 555.name: 18th and 19th Century American Architecture and Architects
ARC 555.description: Studies early American architecture and urbanism through theoretical, technological and cultural development.

review.rationale: Historical built environments establish human context.

ARC 558.name: Theories of Landscape Architecture
ARC 558.description: Examines landscape-design theories in relation to climate resilience, heat and health.

review.rationale: Applied landscape and environmental design are explicit.

ARC 560.name: Contemporary Latin American Architecture
ARC 560.description: Traces Latin American modernist and contemporary architecture, urban plans and international influences.

review.rationale: Historical and cultural architectural analysis organize the course.

ARC 568.name: History of Architecture II: Baroque through Contemporary
ARC 568.description: Studies architecture and urban design from the late sixteenth century through the present.

review.rationale: Historical monuments, housing and regional building traditions define the subject.

ARC 570.name: Modern Architecture
ARC 570.description: Studies the history of architecture, landscape and cities in the modern era.

review.rationale: Historical built environments are explicit.

ARC 572.name: Selected Topics in World Architecture
ARC 572.description: Studies architectural and settlement histories across several world regions.

review.rationale: The stated content is historical cultural comparison.

ARC 574.name: Renaissance Architecture
ARC 574.description: Studies Renaissance and Baroque architecture and settlement across Europe.

review.rationale: Architectural history is central.

ARC 585.name: Special Problems
ARC 585.description: Supports specially arranged individual or group investigations of architectural issues.

review.rationale: The actual investigation topic is unspecified and could cross design, history or technical domains.

ARC 586.name: Special Problems
ARC 586.description: Supports architectural investigations arranged individually or in groups.

review.rationale: The broad special-problem description does not establish the chosen subject.

ARC 590.name: History of Cities
ARC 590.description: Traces cities' origins and development through planned form and economic and political demands.

review.rationale: Urban history and social forces organize the course.

ARC 592.name: Cinema and Architecture
ARC 592.description: Studies cinematic space and its relationship to architectural and urban ideas.

review.rationale: Cultural interpretation of film and space is the explicit focus.

ARC 594.name: Geographic Information Systems in Urban Design
ARC 594.description: Uses geographic information systems for urban spatial analysis, data management and visualization.

review.rationale: GIS is applied to urban design; no AI method or foundational programming curriculum is asserted.

ARC 644.name: The Architecture of Palladio
ARC 644.description: Studies Palladio's architecture and urbanism on site through the Veneto's artistic precedents.

review.rationale: Historical architectural interpretation establishes the subject, without assuming equivalence to a similarly titled code.
